title: moving to a new house is hard - I wasn’t expecting to feel so lost
en: so so gorgeous it is so quiet here

you'll probably be able to hear my dog throughout this entire thing but besides him and all his noises um it is so quiet and lovely right now the sun is peeking through the trees and it's shining light through the petals of the spring beauties on the side of the cliff and it's it's just stunning is just my favorite time of year for sure and it's funny because for me spring is a very sacred time for lack of a better word um it's always a very special time it's it's always the time where i find myself feeling the most energetic and the most

joyous and it's been interesting to come to this season that is such a special season for me and find myself not feeling well and that's been a interesting wake-up call so it inspired me to sit down and kind of make a unplanned video and connect with you and ask you how you're doing and if you're taking care of yourself for me several months ago once we realized we were going to thanks to the kindness of luke's parents purchase a home next to them i decided to extend my work hours because i knew it would be extremely helpful i was just

constantly in that mindset of preparing for this change for me last week was a really profound experience because i made a video i filmed a lot of that video in this forest and there was this moment while i was filming where i was just standing next to a tree without shoes on just barefoot and staring up at the branches just finding trying to decide what i had in mind for the video and i realized i am so happy right now and i've not spent that much time in the forest and then i also realized it kind of hit me like a wave of how bone tired

i was from the last few months how i just felt like constantly working was allowing so much that i wanted to happen but the flip side is that you do hit this wall i found that my anxiety was getting a lot worse and that i was waking up at night with just kind of palpitations in my chest and and this feeling of numbness through all my limbs and having a really hard time sleeping because everything felt so tingly and numb and it was a very strange and rather frightening experience and will i be able to provide for the people i love

will i be able to have people rely on me and not fail them when i made last week's video i loved every moment of making that video and that leads me to what i wanted to say which was thank you because no matter how i'm feeling filming videos being outdoors or being indoors baking or doing crafts or doing anything that i'm able to edit and put together in artistic ways brings me so much joy and peace in my life and and to spend more time outdoors to spend more time connecting with the trees and with the earth and with my spirit and prayer and there is still parts of my life where

i'm letting fear dictate my actions i think i need to take a little bit of time to work on that if you feel so inclined if you could share your words of wisdom in the comments section a community of so many lovely people has so much more wisdom and so much life experiences and so much beauty to offer each other than i could ever offer to you and how you find peace in your daily life when you truly don't have time when you don't really have options when you have responsibilities or people relying on you if you don't have any option but to work as hard as you've been working you know how do you rejuvenate in the midst of all that that's how i've been feeling

recently i've been feeling all these a lot of weight of responsibility a lot that i just put on myself offering love and support to all of you and i think it is so important for all of us to ask for help if we need it yeah so i'm going to try to take some time to work on my breathing and and feeling calm because all this numbness and palpitations and kind of panicky moments um yeah really aren't good for me and take some time to breathe and finish up all the paperwork for this house and finally move in permanently
it's all getting ready for a new beginning and it's happening and i am sending you all my love and i will see you very soon take care goodbye you
zh: 如此美丽，这里如此安静
在整个过程中你可能都能听到我的狗的声音，但除了他和他所有的声音之外，嗯，现在是如此安静和可爱，阳光透过树林，阳光透过悬崖边春天美景的花瓣闪耀，这真是令人惊叹，这确实是我一年中最喜欢的时间，这很有趣，因为对我来说，春天是一个非常神圣的时间，没有更好的词了，嗯，它总是一个非常特别的时间，它是它总是在我发现自己感觉最有活力、最有活力的时候
很高兴来到这个季节，这对我来说是一个特殊的季节，发现自己感觉不舒服，这是一个有趣的警钟，所以它激励我坐下来制作一个计划外的视频，与你联系，问你过得怎么样，你是否在为我照顾自己。几个月前，当我们意识到我们要感谢卢克父母的好意，在他们旁边买一套房子时，我决定延长我的工作时间，因为我知道这会是非常有帮助，我只是
上周，我不断地以这种心态为这一变化做准备，这对我来说是一次非常深刻的经历，因为我制作了一个视频，在这个森林里拍摄了很多视频，在拍摄时，有那么一刻，我光着脚站在一棵树旁边，光着脚，盯着树枝，试图决定我对视频的想法，我意识到我现在很高兴，我没有在森林里呆那么多时间，然后我也意识到它有点像一波多么疲惫的浪潮击中了我
我在过去的几个月里，感觉不断的工作让我想要发生的事情太多了，但另一面是，你确实撞到了这堵墙，我发现我的焦虑变得更加严重，我晚上醒来时胸口有种心悸，四肢麻木，很难入睡，因为一切都感觉如此刺痛和麻木，这是一次非常奇怪和相当可怕的经历，我能否为人们提供帮助我爱
当我制作上周的视频时，我能否让人们依赖我而不让他们失望？我喜欢制作该视频的每一刻，这让我想到了我想说的，那就是谢谢你，因为无论我在户外或在室内拍摄视频的感觉如何，烘烤或做工艺品或做任何我能够以艺术方式编辑和组合的事情，都给我的生活带来如此多的快乐和平静，并花更多的时间在户外，花更多的时间与树木、地球和我的精神联系和祈祷，我生命中仍有一部分
我让恐惧支配我的行动 我想我需要花一点时间来解决这个问题，如果你愿意的话，如果你能在评论部分分享你的智慧之言，一个由如此多可爱的人组成的社区，拥有比我所能提供的更多的智慧、如此多的生活经验和如此多的美丽，以及如何在日常生活中找到平安，当你真的没有时间，当你真的没有选择，当你有责任或有人依赖你，如果你没有任何选择，但像你一直在工作一样努力工作你知道如何在这一切中恢复活力这就是我的感受
最近，我感受到了很多责任，我只是把自己放在自己身上，向你们所有人提供爱和支持，我认为对我们所有人来说，如果需要的话寻求帮助是非常重要的，是的，所以我会尝试花一些时间来调整我的呼吸，并保持平静，因为所有这些麻木、心悸和恐慌的时刻，嗯，是的，真的对我没有好处，需要一些时间呼吸，完成这所房子的所有文书工作，最后搬进去。永久地
一切都在为新的开始做好准备，一切都在发生，我向你致以我全部的爱，我很快就会见到你，保重，再见
